translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Wanushganpita Jesucristo cawarimushgan
Domingo tutami María Magdalena saca sacala aywargan Jesús pamparaycashgan cagman. Sayman charmi tarergan sepultüra saparag rumi witisish caycagta.
Sayta ricaycurmi cörrila cutergan Jesús cuyashgan discïpulunta y Simón Pedruta wilananpä. Chaycurnami paycunata wilargan: “¡Jesuspa ayantami apacuyash! ¡Manami musyayäsu maypa apacuyashgantapis!”
Sayno wilaptinmi Pedruwan Jesús cuyashgan discïpulun cörrila aywayargan Jesusta pampayashgan cagman. Pedruta yalirirmi puntata jucag discípulu chargan.
Saychönami punculapita watgaycur ricargan säbanaslana jitaraycagta.
Simón Pedrumi isanga ruriman yaycorgan. Saychömi paypis säbanaslata tarergan. Jesuspa umanta watapashgan träputapis juclächo churaraycagtami tarergan.
Saypitarämi jucag discïpulunpis ruriman yaycur Jesús cawarimushganta criyergan.
Sayno caycaptinpis manami tantyayarganräsu Tayta Diospa palabrancho cawarimunanpä guelgaraycashganta.
Saypitanami discïpuluncuna cuticuyargan posädaräyashgan wayiman.
María Magdalenata Jesucristo yuripashgan

Marianami isanga pamparashgan cagman cutiycur wagar puncucho quëdacorgan. Wagaycashgancho ruriman watgaycurmi ricargan ishcay angilcuna yurag mödanash caycagta. Jucag jamaraycargan Jesuspa uman cashgan cagcho y jucagnami jamaraycargan chaquin cashgan cagcho.
Say angilcunami Mariata tapuyargan: “¿Imanirtä wagaycanqui?” nir. Sayno tapuyaptin nergan: “Jesuspa ayantami apacuyash, taytay. Manami musyäsu maypa apacuyashgantapis.”
Sayno nir ticraycushganchömi Jesusta ricargan. Isanga manami tantyargansu pay cashgantaga.

Saymi Jesús taporgan: “¿Imanirtä wagaycanqui? ¿Pitatä ashiycanqui?” nir. Sayno tapuptinmi huertacho arog runa cashganta yarpar María nergan: “Maymanpis Jesuspa ayanta apash carga shuntacamunäpä wilaycalämay, taytay.”
Saymi Jesús nergan: “¡María!” Mariata jutinpa gayaptinmi tantyargan Jesús cashganta. Saymi “¡Raboni!” nergan. Raboni ninanga yachasicog ninanmi.

Nircurmi Jesús nergan: “Ama sarimaysu. Manarämi Taytä cagman cutishcäräsu. Saypa trucanga ayway wilamuy discïpulöcunata Taytäman cuticunäpä cashganta. Paycunaga wauguëcunami caycäyan. Nogapa Taytäga gamcunapapis taytayquimi y Diosnëga gamcunapapis Diosniquimi.”
Sayno niptinmi María jucla aywargan Jesús yuripashganta y nishgancunatapis wilananpä.
Discïpuluncunata Jesucristo yuripashgan

Jesús cawarimushgan sacaymi discïpuluncuna shuntacäyargan juc wayicho. Israel runacunapa autoridänincunata mansacurmi puncuta trancacurcur caycäyargan. Saycho caycäyaptinmi elagpita paycunapa naupancho Jesús ricacorgan. Elagpita Jesús yuriparcur saludargan: “Tayta Diosninsi yanapaycuyäläshunqui ali cawayänayquipä” nishpan.
Sayno nirmi maquinta y llapsha pachanta ricasergan. Saymi Jesusta ricaycur discïpuluncuna fiyupa cushicuyargan.
Saypitana Jesús yapay nergan: “Tayta Diosninsi yanapaycuyäläshunqui ali cawayänayquipä.” Nircurna nergan: “Taytä cachamashgannölami gamcunatapis cachaycä wilacuynëta wilacuyänayquipä.”
Sayno nishpanmi discïpuluncuna cagman pücashpan nergan: “Santu Espirituta chasquiyay.
Cananpitaga nogata chasquicamagcunata tantyasinqui jusancunapita perdonashgana cayashganta y mana chasquicamagcunataga wilayanqui jusancunapita mana perdonash cayashganta.”
Jesucristo Tomaswan tincushgan
Discïpuluncuna juntaraycäyashgan cagman Jesús chänanpäga Milish nishgan Tomás manami saychösu cargan.

Tomaswan tincurnami waquin cag discípulu mayincuna wilayargan: “¡Señorninsi Jesustami ricayashcä!” niyashpan. Saymi Tomás nergan: “¡Quevä! Rasunpaypa cawarimushganta criyinäpäga maquinman clävo yaycushgan uchcutarämi ricäman y sayman dëdötarämi jatëman, saynöpis llapsha pachanpa tucsishgantarämi yatäman.”

Saypita juc semänata discïpuluncuna yapay shuntacäyargan juc wayiman. Saychömi isanga Tomaspis caycargan. Saycho puncuta trancacurcur caycäyaptinmi Jesús paycunapa naupancho elagpita yurircur saludargan: “¡Tayta Diosninsi yanapaycuyäläshunqui ali cawayänayquipä!”
Nircurnami Tomasta nergan: “Tomás, maquëta ricay y clävo yaycushganman dëduyquita jatiy. Llapsha pachäpa tucsimashgantapis yatay. ¿Imanirtä cawarimushgäta criyinquisu?”
Sayno niptinmi Tomás nergan: “¡Gamga Diosnëmi canqui, taytay!”
Jesusnami nergan: “¿Ricaycamarräcu criyinqui? ¡Mana ricaycämarpis cawarimushgäta criyegcunaga cushishmi cayangapä!”
Cay libruta Juan imapä guelgashganpis
Asca milagrucunatami Jesús rurargan discïpuluncuna ricaycaptin. Saycunaga manami lapansu cay librucho guelgaraycan.
Cay librucho cagcunaga guelgaraycan Jesusga salvamagninsi Cristo cashganta y Diospa surin cashganta criyiyänayquipämi. Saymi payta chasquicorga gloriacho cushishla imayyagpis cawayanquipä.
